tools.name: get_document_overview
tools.description: Get a structural overview of the Word document including heading hierarchy, paragraph count, tables, and content controls. Use this first to understand the document structure.

tools.name: get_document_content
tools.description: Get the full HTML content of the Word document body. Returns rich formatted content that preserves structure such as headings, lists, and tables.

tools.name: get_document_section
tools.description: Get the HTML content of a specific section identified by a heading. Finds the heading by partial text match and returns the content until the next heading of the same or higher level.

headingText.description: Partial or full text of the heading that starts the section.

tools.name: set_document_content
tools.description: Replace the entire document body with new HTML content. WARNING: This clears all existing content.

html.description: HTML content to set as the full document body.

tools.name: get_selection
tools.description: Get the currently selected content in the Word document as OOXML. Useful for inspecting the structure of the selection.

tools.name: get_selection_text
tools.description: Get the plain text of the currently selected content in the Word document.

tools.name: insert_content_at_selection
tools.description: Insert HTML content at or relative to the current selection in the Word document.

location.description: Where to insert relative to the selection. Replace overwrites the selection. Default: Replace.

tools.name: find_and_replace
tools.description: Find text in the Word document and replace all occurrences with new text.

matchCase.description: Whether the search is case-sensitive. Default: false.

matchWholeWord.description: Whether to match whole words only. Default: false.

tools.name: insert_table
tools.description: Insert a table at the current selection in the Word document. Supports grid, striped, and plain styles.

data.description: Optional 2D array of cell values (row-major). Omit for an empty table.

style.description: Visual style. grid adds borders, striped alternates row colors, plain has no formatting. Default: grid.

hasHeaderRow.description: Whether the first row is a header row with distinct styling. Default: true.

tools.name: apply_style_to_selection
tools.description: Apply font formatting to the currently selected text in the Word document.

fontColor.description: Font color as hex (e.g. "#FF0000") or named color.

highlightColor.description: Highlight color. Allowed values: Yellow, Cyan, Magenta, Blue, Red, DarkBlue, DarkCyan, DarkMagenta, DarkRed, DarkYellow, DarkGray, LightGray, Black, White, None.

tools.name: insert_paragraph
tools.description: Insert a paragraph at the end or beginning of the document body. Optionally apply a named style such as "Heading 1" or "Normal".

location.description: Where to insert the paragraph. Default: End.

style.description: Optional Word style name to apply (e.g. "Heading 1", "Normal", "Title").

tools.name: insert_break
tools.description: Insert a page break or section break after the current selection.

breakType.description: Type of break to insert. Default: page.

tools.name: apply_paragraph_style
tools.description: Apply a named style (e.g. "Heading 1", "Title", "Normal", "Quote") to every paragraph in the current selection.

styleName.description: The Word style name to apply (e.g. "Heading 1", "Title", "Normal", "Quote").

tools.name: set_paragraph_format
tools.description: Set paragraph formatting on the current selection. Only provided properties are changed; others are preserved.

tools.name: get_document_properties
tools.description: Get document metadata including author, title, subject, keywords, creation date, last modified time, and revision number.

tools.name: insert_image
tools.description: Insert a base64-encoded image at the current selection. Optionally set width and height in points.

base64Image.description: Base64-encoded image data (without data URI prefix).

tools.name: get_comments
tools.description: Get all comments from the document body, including author, content, creation date, and resolved status.

tools.name: insert_list
tools.description: Insert a bulleted or numbered list at the current selection using HTML. Provide the list items as a newline-separated string.

text.description: List items separated by newlines. Each line becomes a list item.

listType.description: Type of list to insert. Default: bullet.

tools.name: get_content_controls
tools.description: List all content controls in the document, including their tag, title, text, and type.

tools.name: insert_text_at_bookmark
tools.description: Insert text at a named bookmark location in the document. Can replace the bookmark content, or insert before or after it.

insertLocation.description: Where to insert relative to the bookmark. Default: Replace.

tools.name: get_headers_footers
tools.description: Read headers and footers from all sections of the Word document. Returns section-by-section listing of primary header and footer text.

tools.name: set_header_footer
tools.description: Set header or footer HTML content for a specific section of the Word document.

type.description: Whether to set the header or footer.

tools.name: get_table_data
tools.description: Read the contents of a table by index. Returns the table data as a formatted text grid.

tools.name: add_table_rows
tools.description: Add rows to an existing table in the Word document.

insertLocation.description: Where to add rows. Default: End.

values.description: Optional 2D array of cell values for the new rows.

tools.name: add_table_columns
tools.description: Add columns to an existing table in the Word document.

insertLocation.description: Where to add columns. Default: End.

values.description: Optional 2D array of cell values for the new columns.

tools.name: delete_table_row
tools.description: Delete a row from a table in the Word document.

tools.name: set_table_cell_value
tools.description: Set the value and optional formatting for a specific cell in a table.

text.description: Text to set in the cell.

shadingColor.description: Optional cell background color as hex (e.g. "#FF0000").

tools.name: insert_hyperlink
tools.description: Insert a hyperlink at the current selection in the Word document.

displayText.description: Optional display text. Defaults to the URL.

tools.name: insert_footnote
tools.description: Insert a footnote at the current selection. Requires WordApi 1.5; returns an error message if not supported.

tools.name: insert_endnote
tools.description: Insert an endnote at the current selection. Requires WordApi 1.5; returns an error message if not supported.

tools.name: get_footnotes_endnotes
tools.description: Get all footnotes and endnotes from the document body. Requires WordApi 1.5; returns an error message if not supported.

tools.name: delete_content
tools.description: Delete the currently selected content in the Word document.

tools.name: insert_content_control
tools.description: Wrap the current selection in a content control. Optionally set a title, tag, and type.

title.description: Optional title for the content control.

tag.description: Optional tag for the content control.

tools.name: format_found_text
tools.description: Search for text in the document and apply font formatting to all matches.

highlightColor.description: Highlight color. Allowed values: Yellow, Cyan, Magenta, Blue, Red, DarkBlue, DarkCyan, DarkMagenta, DarkRed, DarkYellow, DarkGray, LightGray, Black, White, None.

tools.name: get_sections
tools.description: List all sections in the Word document with header and footer summaries.
